dedupe_keys.name: ign bd alti french medium resolution terrain model

description: IGN publishes BD ALTI as a regular-grid digital terrain model of France with elevation values at 25 m and 75 m spacing. The provider describes it as a medium-scale product for relief maps, terrain shading and regional or national orientation, not fine building geometry. Its government dataset entry covers metropolitan France and overseas territories except French Polynesia, New Caledonia, Wallis and Futuna. The page says IGN updates BD ALTI from RGE ALTI and exposes government catalogue and map-service links; this review did not request raster tiles or download an archive. The release metadata states Licence Ouverte version 2.0 and public access. Infrastructure modellers could use the elevations as terrain context for broad flood exposure, siting or network-route analyses after checking coordinate reference system, vertical datum and the selected service’s units. A 25 m or 75 m grid cannot resolve embankments or building-scale drainage. BD ALTI complements the finer RGE ALTI terrain product and existing catalogue record data-ign-bd-topo, which represents mapped objects, not this elevation grid.
